C1385.title: V380 IP Camera Hardcoded Backdoor Vulnerability (CVE-2025-7503)
C1385.summary: NVD records CVE-2025-7503 as a vulnerability entry, but the current NVD page does not provide full analytical details. This case is retained as a disclosure record related to V380 IP cameras, indicating that firmware backdoors, hardcoded configurations, or default-credential issues may lead to unauthorized device access. The exact root cause and impact scope still require verification from a vendor advisory or research report.
